longDescription:
Opera is a Chromium-based web browser with a customizable start page, tab management, sidebar tools, built-in ad blocking, synchronization, and integrated communication and productivity features.

The stable release channel is installed from Opera's official Debian repository.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export LC_ALL=C
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

fail() {
    printf '%s: %s\n' 'opera-stable' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"
[ "$ARCH" = amd64 ] || fail "unsupported architecture: $ARCH"

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt ]; then
    apt-get update
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/share/keyrings /etc/apt/sources.list.d
curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o '/usr/share/keyrings/opera-browser.asc' 'https://deb.opera.com/archive.key'
chmod 0644 '/usr/share/keyrings/opera-browser.asc'

cat >'/etc/apt/sources.list.d/opera-browser.sources' <<'EOF'
Types: deb
URIs: https://deb.opera.com/opera-stable/
Suites: stable
Components: non-free
Architectures: amd64
Signed-By: /usr/share/keyrings/opera-browser.asc
EOF
chmod 0644 '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/opera-browser.sources'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends 'opera-stable'
dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}\n' 'opera-stable' | grep -Fqx 'install ok installed' || fail 'package installation was not recorded by dpkg'

rm -f -- '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/opera-stable.list' '/etc/apt/sources.list.d/opera-archive.list'
apt-get clean
